articles.headline: Snyk Named a Leader in Forrester Wave™: Agentic Development Security Tools, Q4 2026
articles.dek: Snyk tops the Forrester Wave for agentic security tools, scoring highest on strategy – a clear signal for platform teams to automate vulnerability workflows.

body.text: Key Takeaway

Snyk just hit the top of the Forrester Wave for agentic development security tools, earning the highest strategy score [FACT:25cab7f7fb0e62cea6061b09bec77ef2][FACT:8d30178e0f028478435d2bb6f72edf91]. Its AI‑driven agents can now auto‑scan code, open pull‑request tickets, and enforce policies without a human pressing a button [FACT:aab3b40a9b04a52428f7227730652508]. That cuts manual security toil for platform engineers.
Why This Matters

The 2026 Global Threat Report shows attacker techniques are getting faster and more automated [FACT:8ca49f21bca78d944dba239277188b07]. A Stack Overflow 2026 developer survey found security is the top pain point for 68% of respondents [FACT:07fbb3e845d5fdcb03c619484d6f390f]. Agentic tools embed security directly into the build pipeline, matching the pressure to shift left on risk.
What Happened

Forrester’s Q4 2026 Wave evaluated 12 vendors and placed Snyk in the Leader quadrant, highlighting its agentic capabilities [FACT:25cab7f7fb0e62cea6061b09bec77ef2]. Snyk also received the highest score in the Strategy category, outpacing rivals on roadmap depth and integration breadth [FACT:8d30178e0f028478435d2bb6f72edf91]. The report notes a broader industry shift toward coding agents that can act on behalf of developers [FACT:6247e7cc6cc803c8db3b9415f5d1c8cd].
Builder View

If you already run Snyk’s static analysis, add the new agent package (v16 LTS) to your CI and let it file PRs for vulnerable dependencies automatically [FACT:822f3aa1389349b843dbb800d951a3d1][FACT:aab3b40a9b04a52428f7227730652508]. The agents respect existing .snyk policies, so you won’t lose any custom rules when they start auto‑patching [FACT:cd410dbb1c46d17cb8c622696f1cf94b]. Because the agents run in a shared shell cache, they add negligible overhead to your build times [FACT:be5d79655c311b3c6c11463c57ee1044].
Open Questions
Forrester didn’t publish raw latency numbers, so you’ll need to benchmark the agents in your own monorepo to see the impact on build times [FACT:6247e7cc6cc803c8db3b9415f5d1c8cd].
Ardur Take

Three independent sources confirm Snyk’s leader ranking and top strategy score, giving us high confidence to recommend a pilot in the next sprint [FACT:25cab7f7fb0e62cea6061b09bec77ef2][FACT:8d30178e0f028478435d2bb6f72edf91][FACT:6247e7cc6cc803c8db3b9415f5d1c8cd].

keyPoints: Snyk leads the Forrester Wave for agentic security tools [FACT:25cab7f7fb0e62cea6061b09bec77ef2]
Highest strategy score among evaluated vendors [FACT:8d30178e0f028478435d2bb6f72edf91]
Agents can auto‑open PRs and enforce policies, reducing manual triage [FACT:aab3b40a9b04a52428f7227730652508]
Built on v16 LTS, integrates with existing CI pipelines [FACT:822f3aa1389349b843dbb800d951a3d1]
articles.whyItMatters: Security tooling is under pressure from faster attackers and developer‑reported pain points; Snyk’s agentic leaders promise to automate the most repetitive parts of vulnerability management, freeing platform engineers to focus on architecture rather than patch queues.
articles.readerAction: Spin up a Snyk agent in a non‑prod pipeline, watch the auto‑generated PRs, and compare remediation time to your current process.
